title: Top-tier plan accounts with recent login activity
prompt: Among accounts on the Enterprise or Enterprise Plus plan as of 2025-06-30, what fraction logged in at least once in the 30 days before that date?
population: Accounts with an Enterprise or Enterprise Plus subscription active as of 2025-06-30.
metricDefinition: accounts (top-tier plan active on 2025-06-30) with ≥1 login usage_event in [2025-06-01, 2025-06-30), divided by all such accounts.
transformationPlan: find accounts with an Enterprise or Enterprise Plus subscription active as of 2025-06-30
for each, check for a login event in the 30 days before that date
referenceSql: WITH top_tier AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.account_id FROM subscriptions s JOIN plans p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id WHERE p.name IN ('Enterprise', 'Enterprise Plus') AND s.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-30' AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-30')) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM usage_events u WHERE u.account_id = t.account_id AND u.event_type = 'login' AND u.occurred_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01' AND u.occurred_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-30'))::DOUBLE / count(*) AS active_login_rate FROM top_tier t
